note: SB-TF-12: per-event coach-mark steps (copied from the owner's Events PNG tutorials/<event>/steps.json without the reference png), native title text, theme accent and the key props the native screen places. Targets: hero, board, team, ranking, map, progress, rewards, timer, start_button. Colours: accent = the title ribbon colour, panel = the dominant panel fill sampled from that event's reference storyboards (tutorial_01..03); rims are gold.
